Instead of expressing doubt about how long they’ll last, gently explore whether they’ve thought about practicalities. For example:

You can’t know “how long it will last,” and trying to predict it will only strain your relationship. By showing that you trust him to manage his life (with your support where appropriate), you’re more likely to keep open communication even if things get rocky later.
